objective: M5 actual-DPI gate at 150% (Phase 1 batch in Windows Sandbox)
scaleSource: User-set Windows display scale on the host (150%). The Sandbox guest is a remote session whose scale follows the host display, so the guest reported 144 DPI; every handles/metadata probe in the qualifying runs reads dpi 144, dpiScale 1.5. No display setting was changed by any runner.

firstRun.note: 45 pass / 6 fail / 11 unverified: V1-005 handle 65x66 px (P1-002, C11, C12 x2), C06 range rect 4 DIP past its cell, C04 link tap (environmental: a leftover popup and remote-session touch delivery; passes in later runs).

fixes.V1-005: Commit 73bfe432: handles placed 1/16 px past the root pixel grid, and the touch target carries one physical pixel of slack (67 px at 150%) so the UIA-truncated size meets 44 DIP at any alignment.
fixes.P1-038: Commit 73bfe432: range/selection rectangles clip whitespace hanging past a wrap to the unsnapped content box (C06).
fixes.P1-039: Commit a40b8655: compact inline image-failure labels trim with an ellipsis instead of being clipped on both sides (screenshot review).

qualifyingRuns.note: Full Phase 1 batch on clean product sources (only restore-generated lock files differ). The 11 UNVERIFIED are the standing receipt/investigation items and the P1-031 cancellation delivery limit.
13 touch/selection cases; all 47 handle measurements are 66 or 67 px.
C06 and C15 on commit a40b8655; the narrow-cell placeholder label now reads "Image unavailable: Scri..."

screenshotReview: 55 screenshots of the full run reviewed. Only defect: the clipped narrow-cell placeholder label (fixed, P1-039). Other observations are intended behavior: handles clamp to stay fully inside the viewport (start handle up to 22 DIP right of a left-edge selection), the end handle after a final atomic object sits at that full-width block's after-endpoint, math highlight hugs its glyphs.
